units.source_text: 朱雀院寄信与三公主，说道：“近来颇有所感，似觉大限将临，思之不胜黯然。

en.t: Emperor Suzaku sent a letter to the Third Princess, saying, "Lately I have been deeply moved by many thoughts, and it seems to me that the end of my life is near, which fills me with sorrow.

units.source_text: 我于现世之事，早已无所留恋，但望与汝再见一面。

en.t: I have long since ceased to cling to the affairs of this world, but I only wish to see you once more.

units.source_text: 如不可得，我将抱恨长终。

en.t: If that cannot be granted, I shall die with lasting regret.

units.source_text: 不须铺张，微行来此可也。”

en.t: There is no need for any display; you may simply come here quietly."

units.source_text: 源氏闻之，对三公主言道：“正应当如此才好。

en.t: When Genji heard this, he said to the Third Princess, "That is exactly what you ought to do.

units.source_text: 即使上皇不言，你也应该先意承旨。

en.t: Even if the retired emperor had not said so, you should have anticipated his wishes.

units.source_text: 如今劳他盼待，其实对他不起。”

en.t: To make him wait and long for you like this is truly failing in your duty to him."

units.source_text: 于是三公主决心前往探望朱雀院。

en.t: The Third Princess therefore resolved to go and visit Emperor Suzaku.

units.source_text: 然而无缘无故，贸然去访，似乎不成体统。

en.t: Yet to visit suddenly without any proper occasion seemed rather improper.

units.source_text: 源氏便考虑访问的借口。

en.t: Genji therefore considered what pretext they might use for the visit.

units.source_text: 忽然想起，明年朱雀院五十岁，可以办些新菜，前往贺寿。

en.t: It suddenly occurred to him that Emperor Suzaku would turn fifty the next year, and that they could prepare young herbs and go to offer birthday congratulations.

units.source_text: 便准备种种僧装，计划素斋食品。

en.t: He accordingly prepared various monks' robes and planned vegetarian offerings.

units.source_text: 出家之人，凡事与俗人不同，故须特别设计，仔细考虑。

en.t: Since one who has taken religious vows differs from ordinary lay people in all things, every detail had to be specially devised and carefully considered.

units.source_text: 朱雀院在俗之时，对音乐深感兴趣。

en.t: When Emperor Suzaku was still in secular life, he had taken a deep interest in music.

units.source_text: 故舞人与乐人，必须用心选择，全用技术优越之人。

en.t: Thus the dancers and musicians had to be chosen with great care, and only those of outstanding skill were used.

units.source_text: 髭黑右大臣有两个儿子，夕雾左大将有云居雁所生二子及典侍所生一子，共三人，

en.t: The Right Minister Higekuro had two sons, and the Left General Yugiri had three sons in all, two born to Kumoi no Kari and one born to a court lady,

units.source_text: 此外另有满七岁的几个小孩，这些孩子都当了殿上童。

en.t: and in addition there were several children who had reached the age of seven, all of whom became palace pages.

units.source_text: 萤兵部卿亲王家尚未行冠礼的王孙、所有适当的亲王家的子孙，以及其他人家的儿童，都被选用。

en.t: The uncrowned royal grandsons from Prince Hotaru Hyobukyo's household, suitable children from all the princely houses, and children from other families as well were all selected.

units.source_text: 凡上殿的童子，相貌都很俊俏。

en.t: All the boys who served in the palace were very handsome in appearance.

units.source_text: 在各种舞蹈之中选取特别优美的舞姿，种类不计其数。

en.t: From among the various dances, especially graceful forms were selected, and their kinds were beyond counting.

units.source_text: 这是规模宏大的盛会，故入选之人大家用心练习。

en.t: Because this was a grand celebration on a large scale, everyone who had been chosen practiced with great care.

units.source_text: 有关此道的专门乐师及精通技术的人，都忙于教练，无有暇晷。

en.t: The professional musicians connected with this art and those skilled in its techniques were all busy teaching and training, with no leisure at all.
